lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice recognizing common -s passive forms in everyday notices and plans.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues react to a simple update such as a cancelled meeting or changed service.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Understanding practical information when the actor is not important.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik notice that a meeting, bus, lunch, or activity has been changed or cancelled and decide what to do next.

main_focus.name: -s passive recognition
main_focus.description: Use and recognize common passive forms such as ställs in, serveras, and ändras in practical contexts.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use common -s passive forms naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: advanced passive with bli plus participle
agent phrases with av as the focus

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use passive chunks that sound like normal practical updates.

dialogue_shape.opening: They notice or mention a practical update.
dialogue_shape.middle: They interpret what the passive update means for their plan.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose the next practical step.

target_complexity.repetition: a few passive forms are enough; comprehension matters more than production

focus: how the update changes the plan
the next step chosen after the update

sentence_focus: one sentence asking what the update means
one sentence saying what happens next
